scope: Deterministic fixed-fixture UI task correctness, action/evidence-exposure counts, and separate preview/document geometry. No timings, human comprehension or speedup claims.
setup_excluded_from_task_counts: Expand instrumentation and activate start-trial to clear setup counts and close evidence
five_tasks: Identify R1, ALL(A,B,C), NOT_EVALUATED, and excluded B
Open exact B via baseline directory or candidate contextual shortcut and inspect core identity/revision/dates/scope/access; close
Identify separate R2 ALL(A,D) without acceptance
Preserve incomplete coverage, UNASSESSED/NOT_REVIEWED targets and engineering non-support

Restore B and request common fixed-fixture re-evaluation; inspect A/B identities, observed/recorded revision, freshness, bytes, access/availability and W1 owner/HOLD; confirm PROPOSED/PREVIEW_ONLY/NONE/no provider result
identity_exposure_count: Every source-panel exposure plus both preview passports; preview is not treated as zero reading.
necessary_recheck: One explicit re-evaluation of fixed inputs; no repeated source panels when checked preview already exposes required fields. This is not live freshness or a new digest.
correctness_gate: All five tasks and identical baseline/candidate semantic outputs before descriptive comparison; no saturation, missing record, failed refusal or stale preview
diagnostics_separate: mode switches, reset, refresh and navigation
warm access loss and snapshot invalidation
geometry: Default and expanded preview-section bounding height and document scroll height separately. 9070px historical reference is only the old 320px/200%-text preview-section screenshot height.
older_evidence: Original NOT_COMPARABLE result and prior browser runs remain historical evidence for the old UI, not overwritten.
